headline: What's Going On With Oracle Stock This Week?
summary: Oracle Corp (NYSE:ORCL) shares are trading higher Thursday. The company expanded its cloud partnership with Amazon Web Services and rolled out a new database offering, adding to a string of announcements lifting AI infrastructure stocks this week.
